numbering.explanation: Galaxy uses Full Menu groups (10,20,…70) and option numbers (11,21,51…). A group is a navigation heading, so Engineer 1 → Parameters is 51, not 50.51. Nested parameters are expressed as option addresses such as 51.46. The code field is the local displayed number; address is present only for a supported option address. User/zone/module selection and value codes are separate contexts.

examples.meaning: Full Menu Display Zones; # changes the selected zone’s descriptor line to readings.
Parameters → Resistance Select; this is a system preset.
The selected zone’s Res. Select attribute; the zone instance is required.
Intruder function value; not Full Menu option 03.
Both are factory routes to Display Zones, but Quick slots can be reconfigured.

caveats: Dotted addresses describe option nesting, not a universal uninterrupted digit string to type from every screen.
Numbers in tables, chapter headings and display cycles are not automatically menu shortcuts.
The * glyph is sometimes extracted as 7 in this PDF; key actions were checked against the page image.
Do not apply Dimension numbering to Flex, G2 or earlier Galaxy families without a separate manual baseline.
Group rights, hardware presence and format/mode selections can hide options.

navigation.action: Move forwards/backwards through available menu options; lists wrap. In Display Log, A moves newer and B older.
Enter the selected menu or accept the displayed value, except where the active command explicitly starts an operation.
Return/cancel in ordinary value entry, but text editors can save on esc. Use the source for the active screen.
Choose a valid option at the current level, an object address in a selector, or a value in an editor. These number types are not interchangeable.
Toggle the selected eligible zone immediately. esc returns without setting; ent starts setting.
Switch between descriptor and hardwired resistance/RIO voltage.
Context-dependent delete or print action. This is the star key, not digit 7 despite some extracted text.

coverage.strategy: Reviewed section 6 contents, Table 6-1, every option heading 11–71, parameter table 6-8, zone/function tables, output definitions and the detailed communications/timer/access-control diagrams. Reconciled descriptive pages; visually inspected glyph and numbering conflicts. Cross-checked user-guide Quick Menu and selected user flows.
mappedAreas: All seven Full Menu group headings and all 43 top-level options in Table 6-1
Factory Quick Menu slots 0–9, kept distinct from full-menu addresses
All 75 parameter slots, including unavailable 40/43 and documented suboptions
All ten zone attributes, 52 function slots, resistance choices and custom SIA values
All seven output attributes and 81 output-function values
User/card programming, timer control, remote access and access authorisation
Seven communications interfaces with shared protocol references and explicit module/format conditions
Latest/historical diagnostics, group configuration, custom zones, schedules and pre-checks
MAX/DCM access-control branches, card formats and conditional SPI-key choices
excludedAreas: No claim of current/unspecified firmware completeness or exact screen pagination/timing
Per-device instance counts and live values are not fabricated; selectors are represented once
Repeated internal/external protocol branches use explicit source links where the manual says they share a structure
Some scalar value ranges, every on/off repetition and complete transition state machines remain in the linked manual
TouchCenter setup, standalone RF-RIO setup, wiring/hardware installation, library words, SIA/CID event-code tables and log-message dictionaries are outside this Mk7 menu atlas
No simulator support is implied by a menu reference; existing seven Galaxy exercises remain the supported interactive tasks
coverage.confidence: Documented archived baseline. Known source conflicts and live-system dependencies are explicit; this is not a zero-error or universal firmware claim.
